VEDL.label: aluminium, zinc and iron ore producers
VEDL.note: Vedanta spans aluminium, zinc, iron ore and oil, so no single industry fits. Peers are the listed producers in its main businesses. Hindustan Zinc is a Vedanta subsidiary, so its results also flow into Vedanta's.

ASIANPAINT.label: paint and coatings makers
ASIANPAINT.note: Screener groups Asian Paints with consumer durables like electronics makers. Paint companies, plus Pidilite for home improvement, are the comparison analysts use.

TITAN.label: listed jewellers
TITAN.note: Most of Titan's revenue comes from jewellery, so it is compared with listed jewellers rather than other consumer durables.

LT.label: engineering and capital goods majors
LT.note: L&T is far larger than other construction firms. Engineering and capital goods majors are the usual comparison.

RELIANCE.label: the leaders in each of its businesses
RELIANCE.note: Reliance earns from refining, telecom (Jio) and retail. Each business is valued very differently, refiners near 5 to 10 times earnings and retailers near 80 to 100, so a single peer median would mean nothing. The leaders in each business are shown for reference, without a cheaper or richer verdict.
